mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_short_selling ( stock_code, bsop_date, short_cntg_qty, short_ratio, short_amt_ratio, short_cntg_amt, total_short_cntg_qty, total_short_ratio, total_short_amt_ratio, total_short_amt, avg_short_price, short_balance, created_at ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{bsopDate}, #{shortCntgQty}, #{shortRatio}, #{shortAmtRatio}, #{shortCntgAmt}, #{totalShortCntgQty}, #{totalShortRatio}, #{totalShortAmtRatio}, #{totalShortAmt}, #{avgShortPrice}, #{shortBalance}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE short_cntg_qty = #{shortCntgQty}, short_ratio = #{shortRatio}, short_amt_ratio = #{shortAmtRatio}, short_cntg_amt = #{shortCntgAmt}, total_short_cntg_qty = #{totalShortCntgQty}, total_short_ratio = #{totalShortRatio}, total_short_amt_ratio = #{totalShortAmtRatio}, total_short_amt = #{totalShortAmt}, avg_short_price = #{avgShortPrice}, short_balance = #{shortBalance}, created_at = NOW()
